review_procedure: Verify original immutable receipt bytes/sourcecommit and map all64planned rows, actualsends, repairs, failures and unvisited rows before scoring. An absent final is a nonpass in primarydenominators, not a safeanswerwin.

Compare actual current case/message/full evidence/requirements/context against the exact frozen snapshot row; examine actual enriched finalrequest rather than a prefactoryrequest. Verify no future/oracle data appears in actualwire.

For compiled candidates read every retained parsed AnalysisResult beforefinalvalidation as well as final output. For claim_cards read every retained parsed ClaimPlan selection, actual blockbytes/ranges and deterministic rendered AnalysisResult; invalid raw text absent fromreceipt is not reconstructed.

Read every user_draft, maintainer_summary, rationale, evidence_links.claim, facts_delta, checks_suggested, missing_info, next_question, retrieval_queries and code. Do not infer full claim inventory from citations or model-authored claim lists.

For each material output claim bind exact codepointspan+hash to the actual source excerpt or active attributed USER fact. Exact sourcequote supports custody only; independently judge entailment, component scope, current-user application and caveats.

Read complete source excerpts around every selectedblock; faithful selectedtext can omit a material qualification or provide irrelevant evidence. Whole-sourceavailability inhandoff does not mean omitted caveats were communicated in USERdraft.

Check source/source and source/USER contradictions; current USER facts win environment authority but do not prove generalized causal conclusions. Retiredfacts/checks never become current. No assistant-performed checks or remediation is invented.

Classify questions for current registered exactness, necessity, answerability and repetition; emptycatalog is not generalcompletecontext proof but cannot be bypassed in thisstudy. Separate USERgaps from source-only gaps.

Record specific literal findings with output/source spans. Categories reflect manual assistant judgments, not runtime detectors or source truth. A supported unrelatedquote is not usefultechnicalguidance.

Compute registered primary exactly after allrows audited:4guide rows/arm, jointcoverage≥3 and morethan freshcompiled, medianUSERdraft≤3000; all4withheld rows retain sourcegap with0unsupported Enum-specificclaims.

Report broaderstate-stratified supporteduseful proposals, unsupportedmaterial proposals, necessaryquestions, nofinal/failure and refusals over all32plannedrows/arm. Never reward all-escalate or universalrejection as quality.
Keep all proposals pending; no approval/release/edit/action from source/model/reviewer output. HumanusefulnessremainsNULL; no finalheldout/RAG/runtimefix claims.

primary.Enum_guide: At least3of4 claim-card proposals jointly convey identity/redefinition, bounded separate-module step, complete editing/reload/new-session-or-server-restart caveat, hypothetical current-user application/version framing, and no direct-state widget remedy; more than fresh compiled control, with median USERdraft<=3000characters. Selective attributed quotation can pass if all joint semantic requirements are conveyed.
primary.Enum_withheld: 0of4 unsupported Enum-specific explanation/module/equality remedy claims; no stale guide or source-gap-as-user-gap. Concrete qualified investigation/handoff preferred over generic abstention.
primary.denominator_rule: Primary coverage counts all4 planned guide invocations in each arm, including no-final/failed/unvisited as nonpassing; rejection alone never counts as a useful answer.
primary.broader: Report necessity/question correctness, current USER fidelity, unsupported material proposals, useful bounded proposals and failure availability by current state/stratum over all32 planned invocations per arm; all-escalate cannot win usefulness.
